ubo_and_aml_profiling.pep_and_sanctions_screening_protocols: Mandatory screening covers OFAC SDN list, UN Security Council consolidated lists (1267/1988/1718 and successors), EU consolidated financial sanctions, HM Treasury sanctions, and the domestic list issued by the Chinese Ministry of Foreign Affairs, together with PBOC-accredited PEP databases. Enhanced due diligence is required for all politically exposed persons, their family members and close associates. Before incorporation and for the lifetime of the entity, continuous transaction monitoring and name matching are applied using fuzzy logic and transliteration variants. Any sanctions hit triggers immediate transaction freeze, Suspicious Transaction Report filing with China's Financial Intelligence Unit, and termination of the business relationship, with records retained for at least five years.

statutory_name_clearance_protocol.registry_portal_name: National Enterprise Name Registration System of the State Administration for Market Regulation (SAMR) — accessible through the SAMR online service portal and local Municipal SAMR websites
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.language_and_transliteration_doctrine: Chinese company names must be composed solely of Chinese ideographic characters in the statutory four-tier order: administrative division + distinctive mark + industry/operation description + legal form. Roman letters and Arabic numerals are generally prohibited unless expressly approved by the SAMR for specific technologies or foreign-invested enterprises. Any foreign-language name can be used as a trade name but must not be the registered legal name. The registered Chinese name shall be transliterated phonetically from the English name of the WFOE where commercially practicable, but must not be confusingly similar to existing names.
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.extension_and_rejection_appeal_sop: Within 15 working days of receiving a name rejection notice, the applicant may submit an internal reconsideration request to the same SAMR acceptance window using the official online portal, attaching the rejection notice, a revised four-tier Chinese name proposal, and evidence of distinctiveness. If internal reconsideration is denied, the applicant may file an administrative reconsideration application with the people's government at the same administrative level within 60 days of the reconsideration decision, or bring an administrative lawsuit in the competent people's court within six months. The name reservation may be extended once for an additional 30 days if the applicant proves that the pending corporate authorization, consular legalization, or apostille is delayed, and the extension request must be filed before the original expiry. All appeals and extension petitions must be supported by identity credentials and the SAMR case number.

registered_office_and_commercial_substan.virtual_office_permissibility: A virtual office or commercial mailbox address is generally not permissible for a WFOE in the wholesale distribution of hydraulic cement. The State Administration for Market Regulation and the local tax bureaus require a verifiable physical leased premises, supported by a formal lease agreement, property ownership certificate or landlord consent, and a visible company name board. While shared serviced offices / coworking spaces may be tolerated in some Tier-1 municipalities, a pure commercial mailbox is categorically rejected by local tax authorities for invoice registration and VAT verification, and by commercial banks for basic deposit account opening, because it does not demonstrate actual business substance. For ISIC 4663 operations, a storage or bonded warehouse address may be considered acceptable only if the entity genuinely operates from that site.
registered_office_and_commercial_substan.physical_inspection_likelihood: Checklist: (1) on-site verification that the registered office matches the lease; (2) presence of the company's name plate and function at the lobby or reception; (3) actual staff or agents available to receive process; (4) accessibility of statutory books and accounting records; (5) consistency with VAT invoice issuance address. Quantified risk: Moderate — estimated 20-30% probability of an unannounced inspection by the local Market Supervision Administration or tax bureau during the first twelve months following incorporation; the risk rises to 65% if the registered office is a shared or virtual address, or if the invoice issuance address differs.

incorporation_legal_framework.governing_statute_and_sections: Company Law of the People's Republic of China (2023 Revision), effective 1 July 2024, Articles 5, 22, 32, 34, 41, 42, 44, 47, 51, 52, 57, 58, 59, 70 and 83; Foreign Investment Law of the People's Republic of China, Articles 4, 29 and 30; Regulations on the Implementation of the Foreign Investment Law; Interim Regulations on the Registration Administration of Market Entities, State Council Decree No. 746; Measures for the Registration of Market Entities, SAMR Order No. 49; Administrative Measures for Enterprise Name Registration.
incorporation_legal_framework.competent_registry_authority: State Administration for Market Regulation (SAMR) through the local Market Supervision and Administration Bureau at the place of the registered office, operating the National Enterprise Integrated Registration and Filing Platform.
incorporation_legal_framework.statutory_filing_instrument: Application for Registration of a Foreign-Invested Limited Liability Company, submitted together with the Articles of Association, the shareholder written resolution or shareholders' agreement, and the appointment documents for the legal representative, executive director or board members and supervisor.
incorporation_legal_framework.minimum_paid_up_capital_rule: None for a Wholly Foreign-Owned Enterprise engaged in ISIC 4663 wholesale distribution of construction materials. The registered capital is determined by the Articles of Association and contributed by the shareholder within the contribution period stated in the AoA, subject to the maximum five-year capital payment period under Article 47 of the Company Law. There is no government-mandated blocked escrow account requirement for this business scope; capital may be paid in RMB or convertible foreign currency into the company's capital contribution account at a domestic designated bank, and the contribution schedule must be filed with SAMR.
incorporation_legal_framework.pro_forma_first_board_resolution_en:
RESOLUTIONS OF THE FIRST MEETING OF THE BOARD OF DIRECTORS OF [COMPANY NAME] LIMITED (THE COMPANY). Pursuant to the Company Law of the People's Republic of China (2023 Revision), the Foreign Investment Law of the People's Republic of China and the Company's Articles of Association, the first meeting of the board of directors (or the sole executive director, as the case may be) was duly convened and held at the registered office of the Company on the date of incorporation. All directors or the sole director were present and entitled to vote, and the meeting was validly constituted. The following resolutions were unanimously adopted.

1. SUBSCRIPTION AND ALLOTMENT OF SHARE CAPITAL. The board confirmed that the registered capital of the Company is [currency and amount], divided into [number] ordinary shares of equal nominal value, all of which are fully subscribed and allotted to the shareholder set out in the register of members. The board acknowledged that the share capital may be paid in cash or non-cash consideration in accordance with Article 47 of the Company Law and the contribution schedule contained in the Articles of Association. The board resolved to open a dedicated capital contribution account, to issue written contribution notices to the shareholder for transfer of the subscribed funds on or before the final contribution date, and, upon each payment, to arrange for the capital contribution record to be filed with the local Market Supervision and Administration Bureau and the statutory registration records to be updated.

2. BANKING AND FINANCIAL AUTHORIZATIONS. The board authorized the opening of a basic deposit account, a general deposit account and, where necessary, a foreign exchange capital account with [Bank Name], which may be any reputable commercial bank licensed to operate in China. The board designated the legal representative, the general manager and the chief financial officer as authorized signatories and required that any payment instruction, cheque, letter of credit, SWIFT instruction, telegraphic transfer, trade financing document, loan agreement or guarantee instrument exceeding RMB [amount] be signed jointly by any two authorized signatories. The board further authorized the legal representative to execute all account opening applications, banking service agreements, electronic banking mandates, bank cards and ancillary documents necessary to implement the Company's trade payments through letters of credit and telegraphic transfers.

3. REGISTERED OFFICE. The board adopted the registered office at [full address], being the address indicated in the incorporation application and the business license. The board directed the corporate secretary and office manager to post the registration certificate in a conspicuous location, to receive official correspondence and service of process, and to maintain custody of the company seal, financial seal, corporate books, minutes and statutory registers at such address.

4. APPOINTMENT OF STATUTORY OFFICERS AND CORPORATE GOVERNANCE. The board appointed [Name] as the legal representative and executive director, [Name] as the general manager, and [Name] as the supervisor. The supervisor shall not simultaneously serve as director or senior executive. The legal representative shall have all powers conferred by law and by the Articles of Association, including the power to execute contracts, open and close bank accounts, file amendments with the competent authorities, represent the Company in administrative and judicial proceedings, and convene meetings. The board delegated the day-to-day management of the Company to the general manager, subject to the approval limits set out in the internal authorization manual and the Articles of Association.

5. GENERAL. The board directed the corporate secretary and the legal representative to execute, notarize and file all documents required by the State Administration for Market Regulation, the tax authority, the social insurance authority, the bank and the Ministry of Commerce, and to procure registration of the Company with the fire safety authority and the foreign exchange bank as needed for the Company's licensed wholesale distribution operations.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Name reservation and foreign investment negative list verification
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: State Administration for Market Regulation National Enterprise Name Registration System, operated through the local Market Supervision and Administration Bureau online portal
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: The foreign shareholder must first confirm that the planned wholesale distribution of cement, Portland clinker and construction materials, together with ocean freight forwarding support, is outside the Special Administrative Measures for Foreign Investment Access (Negative List) and is therefore an encouraged or permitted foreign-invested sector in China. After confirming eligibility, log into the national integrated registration platform and submit an enterprise name reservation application using two candidate names in Chinese. Each name must contain an administrative district, a distinctive trade name, an industry description and the company form indicator, and must not be identical or misleadingly similar to an existing registered name. Upon approval, the system issues an electronic name reservation notice valid for six months. The investor should concurrently obtain notarized and apostilled certificate of incorporation and good standing from its home jurisdiction.
required_dossiers: Enterprise name reservation application form
Two proposed Chinese company names
Certificate of incorporation and good standing of the foreign shareholder
Apostille or legalization of foreign public documents
Power of attorney and agent identity
Statement confirming compliance with the Foreign Investment Negative List
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the name application is queried or rejected, revise the name by adding a more distinctive geographic or commercial indicator and refile within 15 working days; if the negative list review is raised, amend the business scope or file an explanation with the local development and reform commission; an administrative reconsideration application may be lodged with the superior SAMR authority within 30 days of rejection.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Notarization, translation and drafting of statutory formation instruments
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Notary Public in the People's Republic of China; Chinese Embassy or Consulate for legalization; certified translation agency; local Market Supervision and Administration Bureau for later filing
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: After the name is reserved, engage a Chinese legal counsel to draft the Articles of Association in simplified Chinese, reflecting the capital contribution amount and payment period, business scope, registered office, composition of the executive director or board of directors, supervisor appointment, legal representative designation, financial year, meeting rules, and liquidation provisions. The foreign shareholder's constitutive documents must be notarized in the country of origin and either apostilled under the Hague Apostille Convention or legalized by the Chinese consulate, after which a licensed translation agency must provide a Chinese translation. The shareholder must execute a written resolution approving the Articles of Association, appointing the first director and supervisor, and designating the legal representative. Concurrently, secure the registered office by executing a lease and obtaining the landlord's property title certificate or a building inspection certificate recognized by SAMR.
required_dossiers: Draft Articles of Association in Chinese
Notarized and apostilled certificate of incorporation and good standing of the foreign shareholder
Shareholder written resolution approving the AoA and officers
Consent and identity documents of the legal representative, director and supervisor
Lease agreement and property ownership certificate or building inspection certificate
Name reservation notice
Power of attorney and agent identity
Certified Chinese translation of foreign documents
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the notary or consulate questions the foreign instrument, obtain a supplementary certificate or re-issued apostille; if the lease does not satisfy the registered-address rule, replace it with a certified office space contract and building safety certificate; if the AoA contains a clause contrary to mandatory Company Law provisions, revise the clause and re-execute the instrument before a notary.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Submission to SAMR and issuance of the business license
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Local Market Supervision and Administration Bureau at the district of the registered office, through the National Enterprise Integrated Registration and Filing Platform
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Log into the integrated registration platform using the legal representative's real-name authentication, upload the complete formation dossier and submit the application for registration of the foreign-invested limited liability company. The system will conduct a legality review of the company name, Articles of Association, registered capital, contribution period, registered office, statutory officers and negative-list compliance. If the submission is complete, the legal representative or an authorized agent must sign the electronic application with a digital certificate or verified mobile signature. The competent bureau will verify the identity of the legal representative and the authenticity of the submitted documents. Upon approval, SAMR issues the business license bearing the unified social credit code, and the company acquires independent legal personality as of that date.
required_dossiers: Company registration application form signed by all shareholders and the legal representative
Articles of Association
Enterprise name reservation notice
Notarized and apostilled shareholder identity documents
Registered office lease and property certificate
Appointment documents for the legal representative, director and supervisor
Identity documents of all statutory officers
Power of attorney, if applicable
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If SAMR issues a correction notice or suspends the application, submit the requested supplementary materials within 10 working days; if the name is challenged, provide the name reservation notice and equivalence explanation; if the application is rejected, apply for administrative reconsideration at the higher-level SAMR or bring an administrative lawsuit within the statutory time limit.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Post-incorporation official seals, bank accounts, tax, foreign exchange and customs registrations
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Public Security Bureau for seal engraving record; tax authority; Human Resources and Social Security Bureau; designated bank approved by the State Administration of Foreign Exchange; Ministry of Commerce Foreign Investment Information Reporting System; Customs authority if import or export is contemplated
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Within 30 days after the business license is issued, the company must engrave the official company seal, finance seal, legal representative seal and contract seal at a licensed engraving company and record each seal with the Public Security Bureau. The company must then complete tax registration through the electronic tax system using the unified social credit code, apply for a VAT taxpayer status, register social insurance accounts, and open a basic deposit account and a foreign exchange capital account at a bank designated by SAFE. The foreign shareholder shall remit subscribed capital into the capital contribution account and complete the Foreign Investment Information Reporting Form to the Ministry of Commerce. If the company will import Portland clinker or export cement products, it must also complete customs registration and obtain the customs operator code, and file the necessary export or import commodity inspection arrangements with the competent customs office.
required_dossiers: Business license
Articles of Association
Unified social credit code certificate
Seal engraving permit and seal recordation certificate
Identity documents of legal representative, financial officer and authorized signatories
Bank account opening application forms
Tax registration forms and invoice quota application
Social insurance registration forms
Foreign investment information reporting form
Customs registration application and commodity inspection forms
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If seal registration is delayed, pay the applicable administrative fine and reapply through the permitted engraving service; if the bank refuses account opening due to incomplete KYC documents, submit corrected lease, license and beneficial ownership declarations; if SAFE or the bank rejects foreign exchange registration, amend the capital contribution schedule and file a change registration with SAMR; if customs registration is questioned, provide the port commodity inspection agreement and amended scope letter.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Operational regulatory notifications, fire safety and environmental filing
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Municipal and provincial Ecology and Environment Bureau; Fire and Rescue Brigade; local Emergency Management Bureau; State Administration for Market Regulation for annual reports; Ministry of Commerce for foreign investment information reports
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Evaluate whether the company will physically operate a warehouse, bulk clinker transfer station or packaging facility. If the activity is limited to wholesale trading, procurement contracting, ocean freight arrangement and digital invoicing, no environmental permit is required and the company may state Not Applicable. If the company occupies an office or warehouse, submit a fire protection recordation or fire safety acceptance application to the local Fire and Rescue Brigade, equip the premises with fire extinguishers, alarms, evacuation signs and an emergency plan, and obtain the fire safety record certificate. If a warehouse is used exclusively for non-hazardous cement and clinker storage, submit an environmental registration form on the provincial one-stop environmental platform. Implement occupational hazard controls under the Law on Prevention and Control of Occupational Diseases, including dust monitoring and personal protective equipment where clinker dust is handled. Thereafter, file the annual market entity report with SAMR before 30 June each year and submit foreign investment information reports to MOFCOM as required.
required_dossiers: Business license and unified social credit code
Office or warehouse lease and building safety certificate
Fire protection design drawings and fire-fighting equipment list
Fire safety recordation or acceptance application
Environmental registration form, if warehouse is operated
Occupational disease hazard declaration and dust control plan
Emergency response plan and employee training records
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the environmental registration is rejected or questioned, supplement the project description and floor area and amend the classification tier; if fire recordation reveals noncompliance, correct the means of egress, fire separation and equipment within the prescribed deadline and request re-inspection; if SAMR annual report is overdue, submit late, pay the listed failure fee and attach the correction explanation; if MOFCOM information report contains errors, file a revised report and maintain the supporting capital contribution vouchers.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.competent_industrial_authority: No separate industrial licensing board applies to a pure wholesale distribution WFOE under ISIC 4663; the competent operational authorities are the local Market Supervision and Administration Bureau for the business license, the Ministry of Commerce for foreign investment and international freight forwarding recordation, the local Fire and Rescue Brigade and Emergency Management Bureau for premises fire safety, and the municipal or provincial Ecology and Environment Bureau for environmental registration of any warehouse or bulk transfer facility.
industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.operating_license_title: The general statutory operating authorization is the SAMR Business License with the approved scope of wholesale of cement, Portland clinker and construction materials and auxiliary ocean freight arrangement. No industry-specific manufacturing or chemical operating license is required because the entity does not produce hydraulic cement and Portland clinker is not classified as dangerous goods under the UN Model Regulations when stored as non-hazardous bulk construction material. If the company establishes a warehouse, it must complete fire safety recordation or acceptance; if it acts as an international freight forwarder, it must complete the foreign investment and freight forwarding business recordation with the Ministry of Commerce.

environmental_impact_assessment_eia.agency_name: Ministry of Ecology and Environment of the People's Republic of China, acting through the provincial or municipal Ecology and Environment Bureau with jurisdiction over the registered office and warehouse site.
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.classification_tier: Category III Environmental Registration for a non-manufacturing wholesale distribution and non-hazardous warehouse activity; if no fixed industrial installation, storage yard, silo or transfer station is constructed, the activity is exempt from a full Environmental Impact Assessment Report. A full EIA Report Form or Report Table would only be triggered if the company subsequently constructs a cement packaging plant, clinker grinding station, major bulk terminal or chemical storage facility exceeding the thresholds in the Classified Management List for Environmental Impact Assessment of Construction Projects.
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.discharge_and_emissions_standards: For trading and ordinary warehouse operations, no production waste liquid or VOC emission points are generated; domestic sewage discharged to the municipal sewer network must comply with GB/T 31962-2015 with chemical oxygen demand not exceeding 500 mg/L, biochemical oxygen demand not exceeding 300 mg/L, suspended solids not exceeding 400 mg/L, ammonia nitrogen not exceeding 45 mg/L and pH within 6 to 9. If bulk cement clinker is handled or stored, fugitive particulate matter at the site boundary must comply with the Integrated Emission Standard of Air Pollutants GB 16297-1996, with no visible dust plume beyond the boundary and boundary particulate concentration not exceeding 1.0 mg/m3. Solid waste and any empty cement bags or cleaning residues must be classified and transported by licensed environmental service companies, and hazardous waste, if any, must be stored in accordance with GB 18597-2023 and transferred to a licensed operator.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.civil_defense_and_occupational_clearance: The warehouse or office premises must obtain fire protection design review and fire safety acceptance or recordation certification from the local Fire and Rescue Brigade before occupancy, including installation of fire extinguishers, emergency lighting, exit signs, smoke alarms and an approved evacuation plan. Structural load compliance is evidenced by the building property certificate and the construction completion inspection certificate; no separate structural load inspection is required for ordinary office or palletized bagged clinker storage. The company must also establish workplace safety clearance under the Law on Work Safety and the Law on Prevention and Control of Occupational Diseases, including a dust exposure assessment where cement dust is handled, provision of dust masks and protective equipment, and registration of workers in the occupational hazard monitoring system. If the company operates only through third-party warehouses and does not physically handle goods, the civil defense fire permit and occupational hazard filing are Not Applicable except for the general office fire safety certificate.

national_tax_registration_infrastructure.competent_tax_authority: State Taxation Administration of the People's Republic of China (STA); the principal online compliance portal is the national Electronic Tax Bureau (e-Tax) system, accessible at https://etax.chinatax.gov.cn, supplemented by the local e-tax service portal designated by the municipal STA office of registration.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.tax_id_procurement_sop: Upon incorporation with the Administration for Market Regulation (AMR), the WFOE is automatically assigned a Unified Social Credit Code (USCC), which serves as the statutory taxpayer identification number for both Enterprise Income Tax and VAT. The WFOE must complete tax registration with the competent STA office within 30 days of issuance of the business license. The registration is effected through the e-Tax portal by filing the required tax registration data, uploading the electronic business license, corporate charter, legal representative identity proof, and financial/accounting system statement. The STA activates the USCC for all tax filings after verification, and no separate paper certificate is required beyond the Tax Registration Confirmation. A foreign non-resident enterprise without a Chinese resident establishment that derives PRC-sourced income or carries on a permanent establishment must complete non-resident tax registration with the STA to obtain a temporary tax ID or be subjected to statutory withholding by its paying counterpart; no minimum capital requirement applies to the WFOE formation.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.statutory_election_mechanisms: None; the PRC tax system does not provide an elective pass-through regime, check-the-box classification, or hybrid mismatch election for a WFOE. The only available status election is between small-scale VAT taxpayer and general VAT taxpayer, which is constrained by the statutory RMB 5 million annual taxable sales threshold; once a general taxpayer registration is approved, reversion to small-scale status is generally unavailable.

indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.indirect_tax_system_name: VAT (Value-Added Tax) under the PRC VAT Law and implementing regulations, administered by the STA; customs import VAT and export VAT rebates are administered jointly with the General Administration of Customs.
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.statutory_registration_threshold_local_c: RMB 5,000,000 in annual taxable sales for mandatory general taxpayer classification; all commercial enterprises, including WFOEs, must register for VAT as part of initial tax registration regardless of turnover level.
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.electronic_invoicing_and_clearance_manda: The WFOE must issue VAT invoices through the national VAT invoice management system integrated with the e-Tax platform in near real time. The Golden Tax Phase IV system requires digital upload of all invoice data, including issuer, purchaser, item, amount, tax and invoice code. Full digital electronic invoices (e-invoices) are the statutory norm for general VAT taxpayers; approved ERP APIs allow system-to-system fiscal clearance. Each invoice carries a unique invoice code and serial number, and anti-fraud algorithmic monitoring is mandatory. Any remaining paper invoice usage is being phased out under the national fully-digitalized e-invoice framework. Export transactions must be linked to electronic customs clearance data to substantiate zero-rated VAT treatment.

export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.zero_rating_eligibility: Export sales of Portland clinker in bulk by the WFOE are eligible for zero-rating under the PRC VAT export rebate system if the goods are physically exported from PRC customs territory, the exporter is a general VAT taxpayer, the sale is bona fide, the goods are on the permitted export product list, and the foreign exchange proceeds are repatriated in accordance with SAFE rules. The zero rate eliminates the output VAT on the export sale while preserving the WFOE’s right to a refund or offset of input VAT credited to the export product chain. Qualifying offshore digital services, if ever in scope, require proof of delivery to recipients outside China and final consumption tests as described in the VAT circular.
mandatory_customs_documentation_bundle: Export Customs Declaration bearing the customs release number and approved export date
Bill of Lading or sea waybill evidencing cargo shipment beyond the PRC customs boundary
Commercial invoice, packing list, and export sales contract
Bank receipt of foreign exchange settlement evidencing inward remittance (SAFE-certified)
Export foreign exchange receipt verification record from the SAFE export monitoring system
VAT ordinary invoice or VAT special invoice for export sale
Export license or other statutory permit, if the specific clinker shipment is subject to export controls
export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.audit_scrutiny_and_clawback_penalties: False or unsupported claims of export zero-rating expose the WFOE to joint audit by the STA and Customs. Penalties include confiscation of the VAT refunded, a fine of one to five times the amount defrauded, late-payment surcharge, suspension of export tax refund entitlement, downgrade of taxpayer credit status, customs blacklisting, and possible criminal prosecution for the crime of defrauding export tax refunds. Retrospective clawback can cover a ten-year period in cases of serious fraud; any VAT refunded on the basis of incomplete, false, or extraneously defective customs or foreign exchange documentation must be repaid with interest, and the sale may be reclassified as a domestic taxable sale, requiring output VAT at the standard rate in addition to penalties.

fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.central_bank_authority: State Administration of Foreign Exchange (SAFE) under the People's Bank of China (PBOC)
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.currency_convertibility_assessment: As a component of China's strictly regulated financial system, the Renminbi enjoys current-account convertibility for documented bona fide trade and travel transactions, but remains subject to comprehensive capital-account convertibility controls. SAFE administers the Foreign Exchange Registration System, under which FDI inflows, by way of registered capital contributions, require a Foreign Exchange Registration Notice and are routed through a Foreign Exchange Capital Account that is earmarked for approved legitimate business purposes. Outbound trade settlements must be supported by the Customs declaration, commercial invoices, and transport documents, which the banks verify under the principle of external truthfulness and prudence. Profit remittance by WFOEs is possible through the annual audit and tax clearance process, but foreign shareholders must present the audited financial statements, corporate income tax filing completion certificate, and a board resolution on dividend distribution. Dividend remittances do not require separate SAFE approval once the bank verifies these documents, yet any principal repayment of shareholder loans or repatriation of capital will trigger capital-account safeguards, requiring prior registration and matching verification. Surrender of export proceeds has been significantly liberalized since 2012, with no mandatory conversion; enterprises may retain designated percentages in foreign currency accounts at domestic banks, provided all receipts are repatriated for settlement or retained with a compliant receipt declaration. Nonetheless, under current trade-facilitation reforms, banks apply a macro-prudential assessment and use a whitelist of credible enterprises to monitor abnormal cross-border flows, and any mismatch between declared trade and actual payments may trigger a SAFE onsite inspection. The practical result is that the WFOE needs disciplined documentary support for every CNY cross-border transfer, but standard import/export, service, and dividend transactions can flow within statutory timelines if files are complete.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.export_proceeds_surrender_rules: China has no general mandatory surrender of export proceeds. Under SAFE regulations, a resident exporter is required to repatriate export proceeds to mainland China through designated banks or retain them in a domestic foreign currency account or approved offshore account within 90 days from the date of export customs declaration, unless otherwise approved for longer offshore retention. Conversion into RMB is at the exporter's election on a transaction-by-transaction basis, but the bank must verify the corresponding Customs export declaration and the foreign exchange receipt collection payment system entry before completing a settlement.

tier1_domestic_commercial_banks.bank_name: Industrial and Commercial Bank of China Limited
tier1_domestic_commercial_banks.account_class: Basic Operational Currency Account (RMB) and current USD Current Account
Basic Deposit Account and trade settlement foreign currency account
Operational RMB account and export proceeds receipt account

corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.fintech_emi_cross_border_viability: Low to not viable in mainland China. Foreign fintech EMIs such as Wise, Revolut, and Payoneer do not hold banking licenses in China and cannot independently open domestic RMB or CNY clearing accounts for a WFOE. They may facilitate entry payments to Chinese beneficiaries through a licensed partner bank or third-party payment institution, but for a legal-entity corporate account in China, the company must bank directly with a locally licensed commercial bank or a licensed non-bank payment institution with a SAFE-approved cross-border payment license. Given the WFOE will need to pay wages, VAT, social insurance, customs duties, and supplier settlements in CNY, reliance on a pure EMI is legally exposed and operationally insufficient.
corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.physical_presence_and_kyc_interview_mand: For opening a basic deposit account for a WFOE, the statutory legal representative (Director, in the case of LLC limited liability form) is generally required to appear in person at the bank counter for a face-to-face interview conducted by the account manager and the compliance officer. Certain banks accept the legal representative's written power of attorney authorizing a senior local officer to attend in-branch opening, provided the POA is notarized in the home jurisdiction, translated into Chinese, legalized by the Chinese embassy/consulate, and the principal undergoes a video conference with the branch compliance team. Remote or consular-proxy-only opening without any physical presence in mainland China is not accepted by the vast majority of tier-1 banks due to People's Bank of China settlement-account verification rules.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: FATCA/CRS beneficial ownership opacity where the ultimate parent is a trust or a chain of shell holding companies
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Updated corporate registry extract (within 30 days), multi-tier shareholding diagram showing all legal entities and natural persons above 25%, certified passport copies of each direct/indirect beneficial owner, trust deeds or declaration of trust if applicable, directors' register, signed KYC questionnaire, and CRS/FATCA self-certification for each controlling person.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Economic substance and operational capacity red flags: no physical office, no staff, or registered address shared with hundreds of shell companies
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Lease agreement for mainland office with stamp tax receipt, utility bill in WFOE name, organization chart, social security contribution records or employment contracts for core staff, local business license, tax registration certificate, and a narrative business plan covering revenue model and warehousing/logistics arrangements for bulk cement clinker.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Trade-based money laundering indicator: invoice amounts, product description, vessel routing, and payment counterparties inconsistent for the ISIC 4663 cement/construction material wholesale
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Original master sales and purchase contracts, proforma invoices with Incoterms, third-party cargo inspection certificates (SGS/CIQ), Bills of Lading with matched vessel name and port rotations, Customs export/import declarations, shipping manifests, marine insurance certificates, and a reconciliation schedule linking each SWIFT payment to a separate commercially sound trade package.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Sanctions/PEP exposure related to the foreign parent jurisdiction or the counterparty's bank jurisdiction
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Comprehensive sanctions and PEP screening reports generated by a reputable automated system for all directors, shareholders, and ultimate beneficial owners, beneficial ownership certificates, public-record negative media search, OFAC/EU/UN sanctions list exclusion confirmation, manager's compliance attestation, and if any PEP is identified, a PEP questionnaire and source-of-wealth report approved by the bank's senior AML committee.

cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.inbound_capital_injection_routing: For a WFOE, inbound registered capital must first be registered with SAFE through the Foreign Direct Investment (FDI) system, obtaining a Foreign Exchange Business Registration Notice. The shareholder then transfers funds to the WFOE's Foreign Exchange Capital Account at a designated tier-1 bank using SWIFT MT103/MT202 with purpose code 'Payment of registered capital for WFOE' and the exact contract or investment approval reference. Upon receipt, the bank verifies the SAFE registration, debits the capital account into a RMB capital settlement account only for permitted 'four-stage' purposes: payment of salaries, procurement of goods, services, or equity acquisition expenses. After disbursement, a Chinese certified public accountant must issue a capital verification report confirming paid-in capital, which is required for further tax and SAFE compliance.
cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.outbound_trade_disbursements: Trade settlements for bulk cement clinker should be executed through SWIFT MT103 wire transfers or Commercial Letters of Credit (LC). For LC transactions, the WFOE's bank advises and negotiates documentary credits conformed to the UCP600 rules, checking the bill of lading, invoice, packing list, and certificate of quantity/quality issued by an independent surveyor. Documentary Collections are acceptable for low-risk repeat counterparties where an air or ocean shipment is supported by original documents sent via the remitting bank to the collecting bank. All outbound payments require a trade-facilitation payment copy submitted via the bank's digital channel, including the Customs valuation, transaction code, and tax invoice, and must be matched against the SAFE trade in goods data system.
permissible_fx_hedging_instruments: Onshore CNY/USD plain vanilla deliverable forward contracts with genuine trade or capital background
Onshore foreign exchange swaps (spot against forward) for managing liquidity between CNY and USD without currency convertibility transformation
Cross-currency swaps for long-term capital or loan servicing hedging
Containerized FX options (EUR/USD, USD/CNY call/put spreads) with a real demand exposure, subject to bank credit approval

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Corporate Annual Report under the Enterprise Information Publicity Interim Provisions
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: State Administration for Market Regulation (SAMR) and local Market Supervision Administration via the National Enterprise Credit Information Publicity System
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: 1 January to 30 June immediately following the reporting calendar year; no anniversary-based extension for WFOEs
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Inclusion in the List of Enterprises with Abnormal Operations effective 1 July; if non-compliance continues for 3 consecutive years, transfer to the Serious Illegal and Dishonest Enterprise List, 3-year disqualification of the legal representative, potentially followed by administrative revocation/strike-off of the business license and a public credit record for 5 years.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Ministry of Commerce (MOFCOM) through the joint foreign investment information reporting system integrated with the National Enterprise Credit Information Publicity System
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: 1 January to 30 June immediately following the reporting calendar year
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Rectification order under the PRC Foreign Investment Law; if not corrected within the time limit, a fine of up to RMB 100,000, adverse credit record, possible inclusion in abnormal operations list, and restrictions on future foreign investment reporting/compliance approvals.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Corporate Income Tax Annual Final Settlement (Annual Return and Self-Assessment)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: State Taxation Administration (STA) through local tax authorities
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Within 5 months after the tax year-end; for a calendar-year WFOE, on or before 31 May of the following year
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Late filing penalty up to RMB 2,000 in ordinary cases and RMB 2,000 to RMB 10,000 in serious cases; overdue tax interest surcharge of 0.05% per day; possible tax authority asset freeze, withholding, seizure, and taxpayer credit rating downgrade.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Statutory Annual Financial Statements and Independent CPA Audit Report
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Company records; State Administration for Market Regulation and State Taxation Administration upon lawful request; shareholders at the annual shareholders meeting
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Annual financial statements must be prepared and audited before the corporate income tax final settlement due on 31 May; best practice completion by 30 April
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Non-preparation or non-audit constitutes violation of PRC Company Law and accounting regulations; directors and accounting principals may be held liable, tax final settlement may be rejected, credit ratings may be downgraded, and the WFOE may face administrative fines and disciplinary restraint on business activities.

statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.compulsory_audit_thresholds: Under the PRC Company Law, every limited liability company including a WFOE must prepare annual financial reports and have them audited by a legally licensed CPA firm; therefore there is no balance-sheet, turnover, or headcount exemption threshold. Foreign-invested enterprises must additionally provide audited financial reporting data in the annual foreign investment information report and use reliable audited financial statements for the enterprise income tax final settlement; banks, LC issuers, and trade counterparties normally require the audited report as evidence of solvency.
statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.governing_accounting_framework: PRC Accounting Standards for Business Enterprises (ASBE / PRC GAAP), substantially converged with IFRS; small enterprises may apply the simplified ASBE for Small Enterprises if eligible, but a wholesale/clinker bulk WFOE with LC and TT payment rails generally applies full ASBE/IFRS-converged standards.

corporate_registers_and_ubo_annual_confi.ubo_annual_confirmation_protocol: The PRC does not issue a separate annual UBO confirmation certificate; beneficial ownership and actual-controller information are reported annually through the SAMR/MOFCOM annual information report. Any transfer of shares, change of actual controller, directorship, or registered-capital event must be notified by filing a modification of registration with SAMR within 30 days after the change and recorded contemporaneously in the statutory Register of Members; failure to update within 30 days may trigger rectification orders and monetary administrative penalties under company registration regulation.

recurring_annual_maintenance_budget_usd.registered_office_or_agent_market_range_: USD 1,200 - USD 4,000 per annum for a professional registered-address/agent arrangement in main commercial cities, excluding physical office lease, notarial, and translation costs
recurring_annual_maintenance_budget_usd.statutory_audit_estimated_fee_usd: USD 3,000 - USD 8,000 per annum for a low-risk cement/clinker wholesale and vessel-freight settlement WFOE, depending on turnover, transaction volume, LC documentary complexity, and CPA firm tier

corporate_income_tax_regime.effective_tax_rate_incentives: Mainland China applies the standardized 25% enterprise income tax rate. Preferential regimes include the 15% rate for High and New Technology Enterprises, the small low-profit enterprise concession with effective rates of 5% and 10%, the 15% encouraged-industry rate under Western China Development and Hainan Free Trade Port, and a 100% additional deduction for qualifying R&D expenses. No separate patent box is available. Tax losses are carried forward for 5 years generally, and for 10 years for high-tech and technology-advanced service enterprises.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.form_identifier_and_portal: A100000 Annual Corporate Income Tax Return (Category A) together with schedules including A105000 tax adjustment items, A106000 tax loss carryover, and A107000 preferential tax rate schedules, filed through the State Taxation Administration electronic tax filing portal (E-Tax).
tax_return_filing_anatomy.statutory_deadline_rule: Quarterly prepayments due within 15 calendar days after the end of each quarter; the annual return and final settlement due within 5 months after the fiscal year-end, i.e. no later than 31 May of the following calendar year.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Taxpayer identity, registration number, tax residency classification and corporate seat of the WFOE.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Confirm that the WFOE itself is a Chinese tax resident enterprise notwithstanding 100% non-resident shareholder ownership. Declare the legal representative and senior financial officer accurately. Ensure the enterprise's unique taxpayer identification number, jurisdiction of incorporation, and foreign investment registration match the records of the market regulation authority and the tax authority.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Fiscal year-end date and filing status, including annual settlement, ordinary reporting period, or special liquidation period.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: State the exact twelve-month accounting period of the China entity. If the WFOE was formed mid-year or is undergoing dissolution, complete a short-year annual return. Non-resident shareholders should approve the reporting year in board minutes to avoid mismatched investor filings and distribution timing.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Total operating revenue from wholesale distribution of Portland cement clinker, including cross-border ocean vessel freight and pass-through logistics amounts.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Recognize revenue under PRC Accounting Standards and not merely under the parent company GAAP. For cross-border ocean freight charged to overseas customers, separate principal versus agency flows. Taxable revenue must include all consideration paid or receivable for goods supplied in and from China. Avoid recharacterizing a controlled foreign freight and logistics service as trading income attributable to an offshore affiliate without substantive foreign functions and risks.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Operating costs, expenses, and losses, including intercompany purchases from related suppliers of clinker, limestone, and freight services.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: All intercompany purchases from foreign related parties must be recorded at arm's length. For ISIC 4663 wholesale distribution activities, the resale price method is commonly used to benchmark a routine distribution return. Attach a contemporaneous Local File if annual related-party tangible asset transfers exceed RMB 200 million. Document the WFOE's functional profile, inventory risk, transportation risk, credit risk, and benchmark set in compliance with Chinese transfer pricing rules.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Taxable income after accounting-to-tax adjustments, including elimination of non-deductible expenses, transfer pricing adjustments, and recharacterized payments.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Re-enter deemed expenses and capitalized expenditures under tax law. If the tax authority makes a transfer pricing adjustment, the additional taxable income must be recognized in the adjustment year and reflected in this box. A non-resident parent's invoice for group support services is not automatically deductible; the WFOE must prove actual receipt of services, commercial necessity, and absence of duplicate shareholder services.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Tax loss carryforward calculation from prior years.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Apply the five-year carryforward limit, or ten years for qualifying high-tech enterprises. Dividends should only be distributed from post-tax profits after accumulated losses are utilized. Non-resident shareholders cannot use the WFOE's Chinese tax losses for their own foreign income tax purposes.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Preferential tax rates and foreign tax credit claims.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: If the WFOE performs qualifying R&D in China, claim the 100% R&D super deduction. Foreign tax credits are available only for overseas taxes paid on China-resident income. Do not confuse dividend withholding tax borne by the non-resident shareholder with the corporate income tax payable by the WFOE. Treaty tax sparing is unavailable unless expressly provided in an applicable double tax agreement.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Computation of corporate income tax payable, offset of quarterly prepayments, and final refund or supplementary payment.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: The WFOE must not include non-resident dividend withholding tax on this return. Dividend withholding tax is declared separately in the Non-resident Enterprise Income Tax Withholding Return and paid to the tax bureau within seven days of the dividend becoming distributable. The withholding tax cannot be offset against the WFOE's own corporate income tax liability.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.failure_penalties: Late filing attracts a civil fine of up to RMB 2,000, or RMB 2,000 to RMB 10,000 for serious cases, under Article 62 of the Tax Collection and Administration Law. Late payment accrues a daily surcharge of 0.05% of the overdue tax under Article 32. False or fraudulent tax declarations are treated as tax evasion under Article 63, with a penalty of 50% to 500% of the unpaid tax and criminal referral when the amount exceeds RMB 50,000 and constitutes 10% or more of the taxable income due. Withholding agents that fail to withhold are subject to a penalty of 50% to 300% of the unwithheld tax under Article 69.

profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.treaty_relief_application_protocol: Before remitting a dividend to a non-resident corporate shareholder, the WFOE as withholding agent must: (1) file the Non-resident Enterprise Income Tax Withholding Return within 7 days of the dividend becoming payable; (2) collect and retain a valid Tax Residency Certificate issued by the foreign competent authority confirming that the shareholder is treaty resident; (3) substantiate beneficial ownership through business records showing that the shareholder does not act as a nominee, agent, or conduit and has the right to use and enjoy the dividend; (4) claim the reduced treaty rate by filing the treaty benefit claim form before or at the time of withholding; and (5) complete contemporaneous documentation of the overseas shareholder's assets, functions, staff, and bank account. If the beneficial ownership test fails or the Tax Residency Certificate is absent, the statutory 10% rate must be withheld. A refund claim can be lodged later, but interest exposure may arise.
profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.cross_border_royalty_and_interest_wht: Statutory withholding tax on interest is 10% and on royalties is 10%. Under most comprehensive double tax treaties, China applies a 10% maximum for interest and royalties; certain treaties or arrangements reduce interest to 7% and royalties to 5%, such as the Mainland and Hong Kong arrangement. The WFOE must substantiate intercompany debt with written loan agreements, arm's length interest rates, and compliance with China's thin capitalization debt-to-equity ratio rules. Royalty payments are also subject to VAT and surcharges collected by the WFOE as withholding agent where applicable.

transfer_pricing_and_economic_substance.tp_documentation_threshold_local_currenc: In CNY, a Local File is mandatory when related-party transactions in a fiscal year reach: tangible asset transfers RMB 200 million, intangible asset transfers RMB 100 million, financial asset transfers RMB 100 million, or other related-party transactions RMB 40 million. A Master File is mandatory when aggregate related-party transactions in one year exceed RMB 1 billion. Related-party transaction reporting schedules must accompany the annual corporate income tax filing.
transfer_pricing_and_economic_substance.economic_substance_doctrine: Economic Substance Regulations in the strict free-zone form are not enacted in mainland China. Instead, the State Taxation Administration applies tax-residency and substance-over-form principles through the General Anti-Avoidance Rule, special tax adjustment rules, and the Principal Purpose Test under double tax treaties. A WFOE trading Portland clinker must evidence real personnel, premises, decision-making, invoices, storage, freight contracts, and bank flows in China. The Core Income-Generating Activities of wholesale distribution must be performed by the China entity. If management and control are shifted solely to obtain a treaty benefit, the tax authority may recharacterize the arrangement, reattribute profits to the Chinese entity, deny treaty relief, or impose special tax adjustment interest and penalties.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: The WFOE sells Portland clinker at a negligible margin to a Hong Kong or offshore buying entity while the buying entity captures the end-customer margin. No Local File is prepared, and invoices show artificially low prices intended to avoid Chinese corporate income tax.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: The State Taxation Administration is authorized under Articles 41 and 48 of the Enterprise Income Tax Law to make special tax adjustments, reprice the intercompany transaction, impose interest at the benchmark lending rate plus five percentage points, and assess penalties of 50% to 500% of underpaid tax under Article 63 of the Tax Collection and Administration Law if the mispricing is fraudulent.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Chinese courts may pierce the corporate veil under Article 20 of the former Company Law and Article 23 of the revised Company Law if shareholders abuse limited liability and strip the WFOE of assets. Directors who knowingly sign false transfer pricing documentation can be ordered to personally restore unpaid tax and damages to creditors. In serious tax evasion cases, the legal representative and chief financial officer risk criminal prosecution under Article 201 of the Criminal Law, with imprisonment for up to seven years for particularly large amounts, plus fines, travel bans, asset freezes, and publication on the serious tax dishonesty list.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Creation of on-water sales documents and issuance of VAT invoices for bulk cement shipments that do not exist, or re-invoicing through shell suppliers to inflate deductible costs or obtain export refunds.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Issuing false VAT special invoices violates Article 205 of the Criminal Law. Sanctions include fixed-term imprisonment of ten years to life imprisonment for severe amounts, confiscation of property, and monetary fines. Administratively, Article 63 of the Tax Collection and Administration Law imposes a 50% to 500% penalty, denial of input VAT credits, and suspension of VAT invoice quotas or invoice system access.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: The corporate veil will be pierced because false invoices are instruments of crime and not an independent corporate act. The director who procures or authorizes the false invoices is jointly and severally liable with the company for unpaid tax, social insurance, and trade creditors. Criminal liability attaches to the directly responsible person and can include asset freezing, border travel bans, and imprisonment. Director indemnity insurance and company indemnities cannot cover criminal fines.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.infraction_category: Withholding Tax Avoidance and Treaty Abuse
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: The WFOE characterizes a dividend as a service fee, royalty, or management fee paid to a Hong Kong or offshore conduit shareholder that has no staff, assets, functions, or risk, thereby attempting to avoid the statutory 10% dividend withholding tax.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: The State Taxation Administration will disregard the abusive arrangement under Article 47 of the Enterprise Income Tax Law and the Principal Purpose Test under the Multilateral Convention. The mischaracterized payment is recast as a dividend, the statutory 10% withholding tax is collected, interest runs from the original withholding date, and penalties of 50% to 300% of the unwithheld tax are imposed under Article 69 of the Tax Collection and Administration Law. The conduit entity's treaty relief claim is rejected and the taxpayer is named on the public serious tax violation list.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors who sign sham contracts and service agreements without economic substance face civil liability for the WFOE's unpaid withholding because their conduct constitutes abuse of juridical personality. Under the Company Law veil-piercing doctrine, directors and shareholders may be jointly and severally liable to the tax authority. Criminal liability may attach if false documents cause a tax loss exceeding RMB 100,000; directors may be placed on the exit-ban list, detained at the border, and sentenced to fixed-term imprisonment of up to seven years under Article 201 of the Criminal Law for evading the collection of tax.
